gazette_location.description_raw_en: The continuation of HING FONG ROAD as a thoroughfare (which was published under Government Notice No. 1023 dated 19 April 1974) and running in a south-westerly direction for about 229 metres where it terminates as shown coloured red and hatched black on Drawing No. NTA/TW/R78A.
gazette_location.description_raw_zh: 作為興芳路（已由一九七四年四月十九日憲示第一〇二三號公佈）之接續部份，向西南伸展約二二九米然後終止；在NTA/TW/R78A號圖則內以紅色及黑斜線顯示。

gazette_location.description_raw_en: Street commencing at its junction with CASTLE PEAK ROAD, SHAM TSENG and running in a south-westerly direction for about 61 metres then it bends to run in a southerly direction for about 95 metres where it terminates at the waterfront as shown coloured red and hatched black on Drawing No. NTA/TW/R79A.
gazette_location.description_raw_zh: 與青山公路深井段連接之街道，向西南伸展約六十一米，再轉向南伸展約九十五米至海傍處終止；在NTA/TW/R79A號圖則內以紅色及黑斜線顯示。
